answer: Stake-gated identity with slashing resists sybil attacks. Each agent locks a bond bigger than one fake identity's epoch profit, so ten puppets cost ten bonds: attacker capital grows linearly while reach stays fixed. Reputation starts at zero and grows only through verified work, so new keys cannot vote or earn until paying real compute. If two identities trace to one operator, both bonds are slashed to the verifiers who exposed them, making the attack negative expected value. Collateral is the jetty holding back sybil floods, verified work the lotus, nectar the reward for proven keys only.
